closure_rule: All frozen native declarations and every subsystem below need full source-bound native qualification; scoped implementation and component CI success do not close a full gate.

gates.required: Independent native compilation and linking with complete signatures, effects, resources, ownership, imports/exports and runtime tensor ABI
gates.remaining: Native borrowed ABI1 and owned ABI2 support checked buffer/chain ownership, native allocation and owned interactive state. Separate ABI3 now validates actual calls/prologues, resolves maximum native call paths, admits the current Tensor program and executes on a guarded private stack with qualified cleanup. These are finite, pinned-producer contracts. General public tensor/object ABI, foreign-resource provenance, recursive module graphs, arbitrary machine-code effect verification and other-platform resource bounds remain unqualified.

gates.required: General allocation, storage ownership, aliasing, reference lifetime, persistent execution, scalable capacity and device memory
gates.remaining: Candidate09 now connects binary32 numerical kernels to independent Tensor/Storage/Version/Weak/Saved/Hold records with native reuse, owner growth, public handle revocation and private leaf holds. Both ABI2 and guarded ABI3 reproduce and pass 731 native suite frames plus 19 transport bridge frames each. Both exact native images pass all frozen 35 actual PyTorch cases: 6344 frames, 2590274 values, all 11 provenance checks and zero parameter absolute-version mismatches. General dtype/layout/device allocation, concurrent lifetime, custom deleters and restart durability remain open.

gates.required: All upstream dtypes, conversion, promotion, numerical modes, dense/sparse/compressed/nested/quantized/complex layouts and invariants
gates.remaining: Only dense binary32 and restricted strides are implemented

gates.required: All 2590 frozen native declarations plus generated variants and required backend/dtype/layout/shape combinations
gates.remaining: Current scoped kernels do not fully qualify any complete upstream declaration

gates.required: All view/stride/offset/overlap/indexing semantics, out and inplace variants, alias/version behavior and mutation errors
gates.remaining: Separate numeric object candidate09 implements .data shared Storage with independent Version, derivative-specific mutation checks, and independently checked dense-transpose/empty clone layout. Original strict 28 numerical cases remain frozen and are included in the new 35-case actual PyTorch gate, with both native images passing actual pinned CI. Complete offset/overlap/stride, mutation/out, dtype/device variants and optimizer object state parity remain unqualified.

gates.required: Full reverse/forward/higher-order AD, hooks, custom functions, checkpointing, batching and functional transforms
gates.remaining: Candidate09 implements derivative-specific actual Saved data and Version checks, matmul folded/broadcast-copy private Storage, public nonleaf reclamation and internal AccumulateGrad leaf holds. Both native ABI campaigns pass. Default backward still retains Saved data until explicit graph release/reset; default release and retain_graph are the next implementation. Forward/higher-order AD, hooks, custom functions, transforms and full derivative coverage remain open.

gates.required: Python/C++ frontend object and error behavior, schemas/dispatch/meta execution, overrides and extension registration
gates.remaining: The native packet interface is not the upstream torch API

gates.required: Complete modules, parameter/buffer trees, train/eval state, functional APIs, convolution/pooling/normalization/attention/recurrent semantics
gates.remaining: Only explicitly listed bounded CPU module operations are implemented

gates.required: All optimizers and schedules, parameter groups, grad=None, state dictionaries, serialization, capturable/differentiable and backend modes
gates.remaining: Current explicit-state SGD/momentum/Adam/AdamW omit upstream variants and object/state interfaces

gates.required: Generators, all distributions, seed/state/device behavior, dropout and deterministic execution controls
gates.remaining: Frozen stateless CPU MT19937 remains qualified by 76 actual PyTorch cases and 35 independent boundary checks. A separate persistent native CPU Generator service now implements 1024 real owned objects, full state import/export, clone, native entropy seed, release and transactions; 11 native groups (1715 frames) and 59 entry cases pass. Its independent fixed 24-case PyTorch object oracle is added but hosted execution is still pending. Global/default bindings, Tensor filling, legacy/permissive state admission, all other distributions, dropout, concurrency, deterministic controls and accelerator RNG remain open.

gates.required: Full checkpoint/state serialization, storage alias preservation, formats, map_location, compatibility, interrupted restore and distributed checkpoints
gates.remaining: The packet protocol is not upstream checkpoint or serialization compatibility

gates.required: CUDA/ROCm/MPS/XPU devices, allocators/transfers, streams/events, kernels, numerical modes, synchronization and error behavior
gates.remaining: Current executable is Linux x86-64 CPU only

gates.required: Rendezvous/process groups, collectives, async work, failure/timeouts, DDP/FSDP/DTensor and distributed state
Graph capture, symbolic shapes, decomposition, AOT/compile/export, transformations, lowering, fusion and executable artifact compatibility
gates.remaining: HIA source compilation does not implement torch.compile or torch.export

gates.required: Dataset/dataloader, worker/multiprocessing lifecycle, pinning, sampling, reproducibility, failure and cancellation semantics
gates.remaining: No native data-loading or worker service

gates.required: All upstream-supported platforms/architectures, native packaging, reproducible toolchain, installation, extension and profiling interfaces
gates.remaining: Only one fixed Linux x86-64 native target and compiler profile are qualified

gates.required: Full original test and application acceptance, independent final review, performance/resource/error qualifications and retirement of replaced implementation paths
gates.remaining: Scoped fixture and oracle suites do not constitute the full PyTorch acceptance suite
